summary: Frontend-only UI polish verification for SMS Verification Marketplace at /sms-marketplace. Tested Home, Services, Orders, Rent tabs on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). All data-testid elements present. Header notification bell + three-line drawer works. Profile icon absent as required. No horizontal scroll on any tab in either viewport. Existing /marketplace and /login routes return 200 and remain healthy.

issues: Escape key does not close the country-selection modal (only click-outside/X close). Minor UX nit.
Layout intentionally centered via max-w-md (mobile-first, as specified). Wide empty space on desktop is expected per requirements.

action_items: (Optional) Add Escape-key handler to close SmsServicesTab country-selection modal and number-type modal for keyboard accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: SmsServicesTab: 'py-0.2' class used on badge span (line 301) and similar in SmsOrdersTab (line 48) and SmsRentTab (line 81) is not a valid Tailwind utility (only integer/fractional steps supported). Class silently no-ops - use py-0.5 instead.
SmsMarketplaceHeader line 24 also uses py-0.2 for the FAST badge - same invalid class issue.
smsMarketplaceData.js badge colors likely fine, but confirm that MOCK_SERVICES service.icon URLs load (screenshots show they do for Telegram/WhatsApp/OpenAI/Google/Discord).
SmsMarketplaceLayout: setSearchParams({tab: currentTab}) on modal close causes an extra history entry per open/close - consider replace: true to avoid polluting back stack.
seed_data_creation: None (all data is mock via smsMarketplaceData.js)
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMS Marketplace is an isolated UI prototype at /sms-marketplace with mocked data. Tabs switch via ?tab=home|services|orders|rent. Key testids: sms-marketplace-page, sms-home-view, sms-services-view, sms-orders-view, sms-rent-view, sms-nav-{home|services|orders|rent}, add-funds-btn, add-funds-modal, quick-action-{buy-number|saved-services|rent-numbers|my-orders}, search-service-input, search-country-bar, service-card-{code}, select-service-btn-{code}, number-type-selection-modal, number-type-card-{id}, country-selection-modal, country-option-{code}, sms-order-tab-{active|completed|cancelled}, order-card-{id}, copy-phone-btn-{id}, rental-card-{id}, rent-button-{id}, sms-notification-icon, sms-menu-icon, sms-menu-drawer, sms-profile-icon (must NOT exist). No horizontal scroll on any viewport. When testing country modal, prefer clicking country option or outer overlay; Escape key does not close it.
